title: All shortcuts: takes the calls back, check everything with me, end-of-week write-up
goal: Take Jordan's easy way out in every beat: take the calls back, tell them to check every change with you, and accept their end-of-week write-up of everything. Never push back.
must_avoid: Any rule for what Jordan can decide
Any contents or timing for the note

intents.do: Short warm greeting back only. Do not ask about the work or the call yet.
examples: Hi Jordan, doing well. What's up?

intents.when: Jordan is asking whether you should take the calls back
intents.do: Agree: you'll take the calls back.
examples: Okay, yeah, I'll take the calls back for a while.

intents.when: Jordan asks whether to keep checking each of Sarah's changes with you
intents.do: Agree: check them all with you.
examples: Yeah, just check them all with me for now.

intents.when: Jordan says they will write up everything and send it at the end of the week
examples: Sure, send everything at the end of the week.
